stylePrefix: Warm children's picture-book gouache matching GourmetProject food sprites, as a 30-pixel timeline token. Large color masses only, 2 or 3 solid tones per object, matte paint, slightly irregular dark-brown contour. Hand-drawn, appetizing, very concise. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark.

typePromptPrefixes.ui: Image 1 is the official matcha-cake paint master. Keep only its warm gouache colors and dark-brown contour. Do not copy its pores or garnish specks. Circular cream disc filling the square canvas, one thin dark-brown rim, one huge centered subject. Hard rule: no tiny color patches. No dots, no specks, no garnish, no candy sprinkles, no steam curls, no inner fold lines, no letters. Every painted region must be large enough to stay clear at 30 pixels; if a mark would be smaller than one-fifth of the disc, omit it. Outside the circle is only perfectly flat solid #FF00FF magenta. Do not use #FF00FF inside. No face, no eyes, no mouth, no character, no typography.
